verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Antigravity 2.0 as a central command center for launching, monitoring, and orchestrating multiple agents working in parallel across projects. Conversations are grouped into Projects, worktrees isolate agents, and remote control can drive desktop sessions across machines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-session management, and detailed documentation of the session-monitoring UI.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: Antigravity 2.0 serves as your AI agents’ central command center, providing a unified platform to launch, monitor, and orchestrate their activities.
Orchestrate multiple autonomous agents working in parallel across independent projects.
Group your conversations into Projects, which can span multiple folders and support custom settings and scoped permissions.
Projects natively support Git worktrees, allowing agents to operate in isolated background folders.
Antigravity Remote Control allows you to securely connect to and drive your Antigravity 2.0 desktop sessions running across your machines from any web browser.
